title: French
description: Everyday French: greetings, family, food, numbers, getting around and your day.

units.title: Greetings
units.description: Say hello, introduce yourself and be polite.
units.tip: Use 'bonjour' during the day and 'bonsoir' in the evening. 'Salut' (hi, bye) is informal: keep it for friends.

units.title: People and family
units.description: Talk about the people around you.
units.tip: Every noun is masculine or feminine: 'le père' (the father), 'la mère' (the mother). Before a vowel, 'le' and 'la' become l': l'enfant.

exercises.prompt: Ma mère est à la maison.

answers: Ma mère est à la maison.

exercises.text: Ma mère est à la maison.
answers: Ma mère est à la maison.

units.title: Food and drink
units.tip: 'Du', 'de la' and 'de l'' mean 'some': 'je bois du café'. After 'ne ... pas' they become 'de': 'je ne bois pas de lait'.

exercises.prompt: Je ne bois pas de lait.

answers: Je ne bois pas de lait.

exercises.text: Je ne bois pas de lait.
answers: Je ne bois pas de lait.

units.title: Numbers
units.description: Count from one to ten, ask prices and tell the time.
units.tip: 'Combien ?' means 'how much?' or 'how many?'. For the time, use 'Il est ... heures': 'Il est trois heures'.

units.title: Travel and directions
units.description: Find your way around a new city.
units.tip: 'Où est ... ?' means 'Where is ...?'. 'Les toilettes' is always plural in French.

exercises.prompt: The station is on the right.

exercises.translation: The station is on the right.

answers: I am going to the airport.

units.title: Daily routine
units.description: Home, work, school and the time of day.
units.tip: Days of the week are not capitalised in French: lundi, mardi, mercredi...

exercises.prompt: I drink coffee in the morning.
accepted: Je bois du café le matin.

exercises.text: Le matin, je bois du café.
